optimizedDescription.value: ListDrafts returns drafted ChangeRepository list entries unchanged; default limit 100; no content.

optimizedContext.value:
# List Drafts

## Rules
- `ListDrafts.execute(options?)` MUST return `ListResult<DraftedChangeListEntry>` for drafted changes
- Forward `ListOptions`, `includeDescription`, `includeReason` to `ChangeRepository.listDrafts()` unchanged; no re-sort/filter/paginate; order=`draftedAt` desc owned by repo index
- Default `limit` **100** when options omitted
- Return `DraftedChangeListEntry` — NOT `DraftedChangeView`, NOT mutable `Change`
- Entries MUST NOT include artifact content, history, derived artifact state maps; detail via `getDraft(name)`
- Optional `description`/`reason` only when include flags set and repo projected them
- Constructor sole dep: `ChangeRepository`; return `listDrafts(options)` unchanged
- Empty → `{ items: [], meta: { total: 0, count: 0, limit: <resolved> } }`; MUST NOT throw
- `createListDrafts(config)` MUST preserve complete artifact-type + spec-existence bootstrap; MUST NOT weaker variant
- Config form → `resolveListDraftsDeps(resolver)` → `createListDrafts(deps)`; resolve `changes: ChangeRepository`; MUST NOT inline fs wiring

## Constraints
- Read-only list pass-through; repository owns order/filter/pagination
